## Title

How AI automation works

## Caption (Instagram)

```
'AI will do your job' has no mechanism in it. Here's the mechanism: a goal, some tools, a check, and a loop. The check is the part everyone skips — and the only part that decides if it works.
```

## YouTube Shorts

**Title:** How AI automation actually works

**Description:**

```
'AI will do your job' has no mechanism in it. Here's the mechanism: a goal, some tools, a check, and a loop. The check is the part everyone skips — and the only part that decides if it works.

Sources:
- Automation follows predefined action sequences, which is why it runs consistently and quickly. (Introducing agent flows: Transforming automation with AI-first workflows (Microsoft)) https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/copilot/blog/copilot-studio/introducing-agent-flows-transforming-automation-with-ai-first-workflows/ checked 2026-10-28
- A model can be given tools, and the framework decides when to call them. (AI agent adoption guidance (Microsoft Learn)) https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/cloud-adoption-framework/ai-agents/ checked 2026-10-28
- Agentic workflows iteratively plan, call tools, evaluate results and correct themselves in a loop. (What are agentic workflows? (Google Cloud)) https://cloud.google.com/discover/agentic-workflows checked 2026-10-28
- The defining behaviour of an agentic system is the loop: plan, call tools, evaluate, adjust. (What are agentic workflows? (Google Cloud)) https://cloud.google.com/discover/agentic-workflows checked 2026-10-28
- An agent combines a generative model with instructions, knowledge, tools and memory. (AI agent adoption guidance (Microsoft Learn)) https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/cloud-adoption-framework/ai-agents/ checked 2026-10-28
- Reliable agent systems need explicit checks, approvals and governance rather than autonomy alone. (AI agent adoption guidance (Microsoft Learn)) https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/cloud-adoption-framework/ai-agents/ checked 2026-10-28
```
